cross_domain_edges.semantics: MBA STP provides macro market segment boundaries; CM Persona constructs granular micro behavioral profiles.
Negative CCC generates operational cash float that directly funds marketing & content production budgets before revenue collection.
Little's Law and TOC applied to Content Production: minimizing WIP articles reduces editorial lead time; Repurposing acts as asset multiplier at zero marginal cost.
Contribution Margin per unit determines maximum allowable CAC and ceiling budget for BOFU conversion content.
ERRC factors become core distinct Content Pillars to eliminate competing on congested commoditized topics.
